description: Per-quarter loan-pricing trend for ONE BDC, from the parsed schedule of investments: fair-value-weighted average credit spread, average mark and position counts, OLDEST-FIRST. Returns {summary, ticker, count, spread_unit, trend}. `weighted_avg_spread` is in BASIS POINTS, normalized at the store (the as-filed column mixes percent and bps, so never average a raw spread yourself). Prefer `priced_borrowers` over `debt_positions` across quarters: position counts are parser-grain-dependent. `quarters` default 16, max 24. Honest-empty (trend=[]) for an unparsed BDC. Pairs with ol_bdc_borrower_dispersion. Source: SEC EDGAR BDC 10-Q/10-K schedules of investments (Oxford Ledge parse); FREE. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.
name: ol_bdc_loan_pricing_trend
